fusions.name: The Unheard Approach
fusions.desc: A silent lunge that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Spend a Life
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Packmates strike from every side, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles; each has a 25% chance to turn on its neighbours for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Righting Reflex
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you leap 3 tiles from where you stood. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Ambush Feeds the Chase
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 5 stamina. Once every 4 seconds.
